name: YugabyteDB Aeon Sandbox Free
free_limit: One free-forever single-node YugabyteDB Aeon Sandbox cluster per account, up to 2 vCPU, 4 GB RAM and 10 GB storage depending on provider; no credit card required.
watch_out: Development and tutorials only, not production or performance testing; up to 15 connections, no backups, no scaling or VPC networking. Inactive clusters may be paused after 10 days and deleted after 15 days; commercial production suitability requires provider confirmation.
